answer:
The Windows documentation gives 551.61 as the minimum: "NVIDIA 551.61 or newer Drivers if you have an NVIDIA card" [ollama/docs/windows.md].

The general hardware page sets different numbers. It says "Ollama supports Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 5.0+ and driver version 550 and newer." It also says "Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 5.0 through 6.2 require driver version 570 or newer." [ollama/docs/gpu.md]

These documents don't fully agree. If your card has compute capability 5.0 through 6.2, the more specific gpu.md requirement of driver 570 or newer appears to apply. You can check your card's compute capability at the link given in that document: "[https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-gpus](https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-gpus)" [ollama/docs/gpu.md].
